description: This file implements the HtmlMenuRenderer class, a Java class responsible for rendering HTML menus in a web application framework. It contains methods for rendering menu items, links, images, and HTML structure, along with utility functions for URL generation and session handling.

classes.name: HtmlMenuRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering HTML-based menus within the OFBiz framework, implementing methods for rendering menu components, handling URLs, and managing session information.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP servlet request object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP servlet response object.

methods.name: appendOfbizUrl
methods.description: Generates and appends an OFBiz URL to the provided Appendable writer based on the given location.

methods.name: appendContentUrl
methods.description: Generates and appends a content URL to the provided Appendable writer for the specified location.

methods.name: appendTooltip
methods.description: Renders a tooltip span element for a menu item if a tooltip is specified.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Iterates over menu items to render each as a list item.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders an individual menu item, including link, tooltip, and submenu structures.

methods.name: isDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the menu item should be disabled based on the presence of required context keys.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Renders the opening HTML tags and structure for a menu.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Renders the closing HTML tags for a menu and manages user session information.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperOpen
methods.description: No operation in current implementation.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperClose
methods.description: No operation in current implementation.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the HTTP request object.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response object.

methods.name: setUserLoginIdAtPermGrant
methods.description: Sets the stored user login ID at permission grant to a specified value.

methods.name: getUserLoginIdAtPermGrant
methods.description: Retrieves the stored user login ID at permission grant.

methods.name: isHideIfSelected
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be hidden when it is currently selected.

methods.name: userLoginIdHasChanged
methods.description: Checks whether the current user login ID has changed since last stored.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of a menu item based on the context.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders an HTML anchor element for a menu link, including possible form for hidden form links.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an HTML image element with attributes based on the Image object.
